item.title: Ryanair Cut Deals With OTAs — but Pays Zero Commission
item.description: It's great to be an airline like Ryanair: Your market clout is so strong that OTAs are just glad to sell your flights without receiving any other compensation from the airline.

item.title: 5 Trends in Airline Loyalty That Defined 2025
item.description: As the airline industry increasingly turns more premium, loyalty programs — already airlines’ biggest asset — are becoming even more important to their long-term strategy.

item.title: 4 Shocks That Broke India’s Travel Momentum
item.description: While the depreciating rupee pressured costs and outbound demand, it was a cascade of geopolitical and operational shocks that truly tested Indian travel companies.

item.title: U.S. Travel 2025: Who Came, Who Stayed Away — and Which States Lost
item.description: Total overseas visitation to the U.S. fell in 2025, but some states are faring better than others.

item.title: Executive Q&A: Inside American’s Push to Make Travel More Seamless
item.description: Air travel has entered a new era, and airlines are redesigning the travel experience from the ground up. For American Airlines, this means leveraging AI, automation, and real-time data to deliver smarter discovery, greater transparency in choice, reduced friction, and enhanced customer care.

item.title: Q&A: Why Travel Needs a New Platform Built for an Open Ecosystem
item.description: Travel’s reliance on legacy infrastructure continues to shape the ceiling for innovation. OnArrival aims to lower that barrier with an open-access platform that gives consumer brands a faster path to launching and scaling travel products.

item.title: Ask Skift’s Most Popular Questions for 2025

item.title: Oyo-Parent Prism Files for IPO, Seeks $7+ Billion Valuation
item.description: Prism filed for an IPO barely a few hours before 2026. After years of missed windows and pulled papers, the December 31 confidential filing keeps the promise alive while buying time on everything else.

item.title: The Live Tourism Events That Will Shape 2026
item.description: There’s no Taylor Swift Eras Tour in 2026, and the future of consumer spending remains murky. That doesn't mean the travel industry is any less excited about live tourism.
